game.title: FINAL FANTASY XIII-2
game.blurb: Role-playing game from Square Enix, published by Square Enix, released 2011-12-15. RAWG average playtime: 4 hours. Genres: RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Story milestones from the first steps in a changed world, through the journey through time, to the end of the story. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Paradox Endings and Fragments
chapters.summary: Every Paradox Ending, Cinematic Bonus rewards, and completing one and then every fragment category.

chapters.title: Chocobos, Casino, Shops and Monsters
chapters.summary: Riding chocobos, casino coins, spending at shops, Feral Link abilities and befriending a most unfriendly monster.

chapters.title: Battle Feats
chapters.summary: Medals against powerful enemies, staggers, preemptive strikes, paradigm shifts, fast responses, big damage, developing every ability, defeating every worthy opponent and the best result in the final battle.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 3993). Steam app 292140 ("FINAL FANTASY® XIII-2") from the store list; its schema name is "FINAL FANTASY XIII-2". None of the 31 Steam achievements is hidden. RAWG's detail says 70 achievements, which does not match Steam's 31. StrategyWiki has "Final Fantasy XIII-2" at completion stage 0: only Achievements and trophies (about 5,400 characters) and a short Table of Contents (about 430) are written; Walkthrough, Gameplay and Controls are linked but not written, so it was not used. finalfantasy.fandom.com answers the API under "Final Fantasy XIII-2" with 500 or more linked articles (the API limit); names only were looked at, nothing copied. "Chronosavior" (best result in the battle to decide the fate of the world) was put with battle feats rather than the story; the eight story milestones follow Steam's order.
